title: ExamLeaf Lesson Graph document v2
description: Canonical, source-grounded store. Edges are typed id-reference fields on the owning node, so they are inside every node hash. Hash canon: RFC 8785 (JCS) after Unicode NFC normalisation of every string; measured quantities are decimal strings, JSON numbers are integers or multiples of 0.5 only.
$comment: Commercial-term lint (CE-L1/RD-49; CE-26, CE-70; updated 15 Oct 2026): CI rejects, case-insensitively, any match of (price|pricing|paid|is_free|free_|premium|entitle|subscri|sku|paywall|unlock|monetis|monetiz|revenue|discount|coupon|tier|destination_resource|cta_destination|funnel|purchase_|checkout_|product_id|offer_|trial_|utm_|campaign_|affiliate_|activation_code|storefront) applied to every object key at every depth (including REN fields keys), every required entry, pattern key and enum or const value. Exempt: the editorial fields series_position, flagship and demo_kind, which carry no commercial meaning.

source.description: Source Registry record. Single writer: content/sources/SRC-*.json validated against this definition. Graph documents reference sources by id only and never embed them; subtree_sha256 includes the sha256 of every referenced SRC.
